name: Mate in one
description: Find the checkmating move on a real board: tap a piece and a square, or drag. Every answer is checked against the engine-verified list of mates.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Shown above the board (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: fen
fields.description: The position in FEN. The side to move is the one solving.

fields.name: answers
fields.description: Every mating move in UCI form (e.g. g5f7). Check them with an engine.

fields.name: san
fields.description: The mating move in algebraic notation, for the result (e.g. Nf7#).
